lines.text: Jesus went to the region of Tyre, and a Greek woman fell at His feet about her daughter.
Jesus said it was not right to toss the children's bread to the dogs, yet He told her the demon had left.
She found her child lying on the bed, and Jesus went through Sidon to the Sea of Galilee.
People begged Jesus to place His hand on a deaf man, so He put His fingers into the man's ears and said, "Ephphatha!"

wrong_details.wrong: put His fingers into the man's ears
wrong_details.true: put His fingers into the man's ears

lines.text: The man's ears were opened, Jesus ordered them to tell no one, and the people said He makes the deaf hear.
